The '''Czerka Emergency Procedures Manual''' was a manual given to employees of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] that detailed what to do in various emergencies. One section was entitled "Twelve Vital Steps for Surviving an Emergency," and its first step was to avoid panic.
